name: ModifyBackupSetDownloadRules

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup plan. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html operation to query the backup plan ID
parameters.help_zh: 备份计划ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口查看
parameters.name: backup_plan_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic download. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启自动下载，默认false
parameters.name: open_auto_download

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup gateway used for downloading backup sets
parameters.name: backup_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
The format of the full data in the backup set to download. Valid values:
Native
SQL
CSV
JSON

Default value: CSV
parameters.help_zh:
备份集下载全量数据格式：
Native
SQL
CSV
JSON

默认 CSV
parameters.name: full_data_format

parameters.help_en:
The format of the incremental data in the backup set to download. Valid values:
Native
SQL
CSV
JSON

Default value: Native
parameters.help_zh:
备份集下载增量数据格式：
Native
SQL
CSV
JSON

默认Native
parameters.name: increment_data_format

parameters.help_en: The server directory for downloading backup sets
parameters.help_zh: 备份集下载服务器目录
parameters.name: backup_set_download_dir

parameters.help_en:
The target type for downloading backup sets.
Default value: agent, which indicates that a backup gateway is installed. Currently, only this value is supported
parameters.help_zh:
备份集下载目标类型 。
默认agent：已安装备份网关，目前仅此项
parameters.name: backup_set_download_target_type

parameters.help_en:
The target directory type for downloading backup sets. This parameter is required if automatic download is enabled. Valid values:
local
nas
ftp
minio

Default value: local
parameters.help_zh:
备份集下载目标目录类型，如果是开启自动下载，则必填，取值：
local
nas
ftp
minio

默认为local
parameters.name: backup_set_download_target_type_location

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent repeated submissions
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求
parameters.name: client_token
